A MITM attack is what happens when a third party hijacks a connection. You connect to bank.com, but through any number of ways instead of connecting to bank.com you end up connecting to a third party -- a man in the middle. When you normally connect to a secure site the first thing that happens is an exchange of credentials to initiate a secure connection.
